entries.d839b24887a50124: Under the management policy 'to become a light that shows the way,' the company regards advertising as a communication medium that connects people, regions and society, and says it aims to create new value by drawing on its track record in producing barrier-free maps compatible with color vision diversity and evacuation guidance maps for disasters, as well as its know-how in digital technologies such as digital signage and Web services. Issues it lists to address include raising added value for existing businesses, improving revenue in the Navita Business, developing Web products and services, and expanding business areas through M&A and business alliances.
entries.dbd017535b3bb43c: Navita is installed near the ticket gates and elsewhere at 2,392 stations nationwide. Although it has become customary for transportation advertising to be handled by designated agencies of railway operators, the group, starting with its original Navita Business, is a designated operator at major stations and in areas nationwide, and states that because it has already installed Navita at many stations, it holds a high advantage over latecomers. The company also has an in-house structure for producing maps and digital content, which enables production of Navita tailored to the area and purpose of each installation location.
